name: CLAUDE.md
summary: CLAUDE.md is the instruction file Claude Code loads at the start of every session. It can live at managed (org), user (~/.claude/CLAUDE.md), project (./CLAUDE.md) and local (CLAUDE.local.md) scopes, and all found files are concatenated. It sits beside auto memory, which Claude writes itself, and .claude/rules/ for path-scoped rules.
facts: @path syntax, up to four hops deep
Read instead when no CLAUDE.md exists (since v2.1.277)
Context only; use hooks or permissions to block actions
goodFor: Team conventions checked into the repo
Org-wide guidance via a managed file
watchOut: Instructions are guidance, not enforced rules
Claude Code-specific; other agents use AGENTS.md
